design_vision.core_philosophy: Functional beauty through clarity, data density, and stark contrast. Prioritize grid-based structure, removing unnecessary decoration to focus purely on educational content, tracking metrics, and administrative control. High-tech, serious, and authoritative.

rules.typesetting: Tight tracking on large headers. Wide tracking on tiny uppercase labels. High legibility body font for data tables.
rules.hierarchy_gap: Do not exceed 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium
scales.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium

colors.strategy: 90% Monochrome structural UI. Color is used strictly for function (actions, alerts, status). No ambient gradients.

surfaces_and_borders.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and high-contrast color shifts on hover for depth.
surfaces_and_borders.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px solid border, no shadow. On hover, apply a slight border color shift to brand_primary, no translateY.
surfaces_and_borders.headers_nav: Solid background (white/black) with a hard 1px bottom border. Sidebar with hard 1px right border.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Avoid in dashboard context for data clarity. Use pure solid colors.

dashboard_grid.gap: gap-px bg-border (to create pure 1px grid lines between elements)

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense data, labels, and forms. Center only empty states or prominent CTAs.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to strip 'soft' elements.

customizations.Button: Sharp corners (rounded-none), high contrast, solid block. Hover state changes text/bg aggressively.
customizations.Card: Remove default shadow. Add 1px border. Use generous p-6 inner padding.
customizations.Input: Square corners, dark borders on focus, no soft rings.
customizations.Table: Dense spacing, left-aligned, distinct bottom borders for rows, zebra striping optional for large sets.
customizations.Tabs: Override default soft pill styles with brutalist bottom-border underlines or solid blocks.

motion.hover_states: Must explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have higher contrast than default.

icons_and_assets.rationale: Perfect for dense dashboards, available in varying weights (use Regular or Duotone for active states).

institute_logo.description: Minimalist square logo for the Institute.

course_aiml.description: Abstract circular node pattern representing AI and ML.

course_cybersecurity.description: Dark thematic lock image on a computer, symbolizing cybersecurity.

course_python.description: Terminal code screen representing Python programming.

abstract_background.description: Subtle abstract texture for login pages or empty states.

specific_features.pdf_invoices: Must use monochrome, highly structured layouts with clear typography. Include Institute Logo. Replicate the brutalist Swiss grid style in the PDF layout.
specific_features.role_dashboards: Differentiate role dashboards using layout density. Super Admin needs dense data metrics. Student needs visual course cards and clear progress bars.
specific_features.testing_attributes: All buttons, tabs, links, inputs must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='student-course-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts using Google Fonts import in index.css.
Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors provided.
Modify Shadcn components globally to have rounded-none or rounded-sm, removing all shadow defaults.
Build the dashboard layout using CSS Grid with exact gap rules (The 'Control Room' pattern).
Ensure all data tables (Fees, Attendance) left-align their text and use high-contrast row separators.
Never use generic placeholder images; rely solely on the media_urls provided in this JSON.
